diff --git a/scripts/ui/altar_station_interaction.gd b/scripts/ui/altar_station_interaction.gd
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/ui/altar_station_interaction.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+extends Node3D
+
+## Mounted on a real committed Altar by the owning build placer. Presentation
+## only: Session revalidates actual world placement, plot, sender and reach.
+const INTERACTABLE := preload("res://scripts/world/interactable.gd")
+const SERVICE := preload("res://scripts/ui/altar_service.gd")
+const ESSENCE := preload("res://scripts/creatures/essence.gd")
+const RECORDS := preload("res://scripts/world/realm_world_records.gd")
+const NODE_NAME := "AltarInteraction"
+var _game: Node = null
+var _building: Node3D = null
+var _uid := ""
+var _station_key := ""
+var _session: Node = null
+var _registered := false
+var _prompt: Node3D = null
+
+
+## Called after committed placement metadata/group; deferred setup sees the
+## final position assigned by the existing delta/restoration caller.
+static func attach(building: Node3D, game: Node) -> Node:
+	if not is_instance_valid(building) or not is_instance_valid(game): return null
+	var old := building.get_node_or_null(NodePath(NODE_NAME))
+	if old != null:
+		return old if old.get_script() == load("res://scripts/ui/altar_station_interaction.gd") else null
+	if building.get_meta("building_id", "") != "altar" or not building.is_in_group("placed_building"): return null
+	var actor: Node = load("res://scripts/ui/altar_station_interaction.gd").new()
+	actor.name = NODE_NAME
+	actor.set("_game", game)
+	actor.set("_building", building)
+	building.add_child(actor)
+	return actor
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	call_deferred("_setup")
+
+
+func _setup() -> void:
+	if not _actual_record_matches(true): return
+	var cfg := ESSENCE.config()
+	var radius: Variant = cfg.get("altar_interaction_radius_m")
+	var offset: Variant = cfg.get("altar_prompt_offset_m")
+	if not (radius is int or radius is float) or not is_finite(float(radius)) or float(radius) <= 0.0 \
+			or not offset is Array or offset.size() != 3: return
+	for value: Variant in offset:
+		if not (value is int or value is float) or not is_finite(float(value)): return
+	_prompt = INTERACTABLE.new()
+	_prompt.name = "TrainPrompt"
+	_prompt.position = Vector3(float(offset[0]), float(offset[1]), float(offset[2]))
+	_prompt.call("configure", "Altar is not ready yet", float(radius), true)
+	_prompt.set("actionable", false)
+	_prompt.connect("activated", _open)
+	add_child(_prompt)
+
+
+func _actual_record_matches(initial: bool = false) -> bool:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_building) or not is_instance_valid(_game) \
+			or not _building.is_inside_tree() or not _building.is_ancestor_of(self) \
+			or not _building.is_in_group("placed_building") \
+			or _building.get_meta("building_id", "") != "altar" \
+			or _building.get_meta("realm", "") != "meadows" or RECORDS.active(_game) != "meadows": return false
+	var items: Variant = _game.get("items")
+	if not items is RefCounted or not items.has_method("buildable"): return false
+	var definition: Variant = items.call("buildable", "altar")
+	if not definition is Dictionary or definition.is_empty(): return false
+	var rows: Variant = _game.get("placed_buildings")
+	var index: Variant = _building.get_meta("placed_index", -1)
+	if not rows is Array or not index is int or index < 0 or index >= rows.size(): return false
+	var row: Variant = rows[index]
+	if not row is Dictionary or row.get("id") != "altar" or row.get("removed", false) != false \
+			or not RECORDS.belongs(row, "meadows") or not ESSENCE._component(row.get("uid")): return false
+	if initial:
+		_uid = row.uid
+		_station_key = "altar:meadows:" + _uid
+	return row.uid == _uid
+
+
+func _disconnect_station() -> void:
+	if _registered and is_instance_valid(_session) and _session.has_method("_unregister_altar_station_node"):
+		_session.call("_unregister_altar_station_node", _station_key, _building)
+	_session = null
+	_registered = false
+
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_prompt): return
+	if not _actual_record_matches():
+		_disconnect_station()
+		_prompt.set("enabled", false)
+		return
+	var candidate: Variant = _game.get("session")
+	if candidate != _session:
+		_disconnect_station()
+		if candidate is Node and is_instance_valid(candidate): _session = candidate
+	if not _registered and is_instance_valid(_session) and _session.has_method("_register_altar_station_node"):
+		var accepted: Variant = _session.call("_register_altar_station_node", _station_key, _building)
+		_registered = accepted is bool and accepted == true
+	var service := SERVICE.attach(_game)
+	var available := _registered and is_instance_valid(service) and service.call("station_available", _station_key) == true
+	_prompt.set("enabled", true)
+	_prompt.set("actionable", available)
+	_prompt.set("label", "Train at Altar" if available else "Altar is not ready yet")
+
+
+func _open() -> void:
+	if not _registered or not _actual_record_matches(): return
+	var service := SERVICE.attach(_game)
+	if is_instance_valid(service): service.call("open", _station_key)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	_disconnect_station()
